It is an auspicious name for a boy child, reflecting the desirable qualities of strength, courage, and resilience. The name adds to the respect and stature of the bearer within the community. It is a reminder of the importance of maintaining a positive and unwavering spirit in the face of adversity. The name is considered to be a good omen, bringing good fortune and prosperity to the family.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "अशोक" carries a deep meaning. It signifies the removal of attachment and identification with sorrow, grief, and negative emotions. It is a reminder to remain detached from the external world and its transient joys and sorrows. By bearing this name, one is encouraged to strive towards inner peace, happiness, and self-realization. It is a name that inspires one to seek liberation from the cycle of birth and death, and to attain moksha, or enlightenment.
